=== SERVICE DETAILS ===
Heading: Foundation Problems Don’t Fix Themselves
Intro: Small warning signs can turn into expensive structural issues if they’re ignored.
Checklist:
- Cracks in walls or brick
- Uneven or sloping floors
- Doors and windows sticking
- Gaps around trim or cabinets
- Water pooling near foundation
- Bowing or settling foundation

=== FAQ ===
Heading: Foundation Repair Questions, Answered
Intro: Straight answers about inspections, warranties, timelines, and what to expect on your property.
Q: How do I know if I need foundation repair?
A: Look for cracks, uneven floors, sticking doors, gaps around trim, or water near your foundation. The safest next step is a professional inspection.
Q: Is the inspection really free?
A: Yes. We inspect the issue, explain what we find, and recommend next steps.
Q: How much does foundation repair cost?
A: It depends on the cause, severity, soil conditions, and repair method. After inspection, we provide a clear estimate.
Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. Financing options may be available for qualified homeowners.
Q: How long does foundation repair take?
A: Many repairs can be completed in a few days, but timing depends on the scope of work.
Q: Will foundation repair damage my landscaping?
A: We take care to minimize disruption and explain what to expect before work begins.
Q: Do you warranty your work?
A: Yes. Warranty details depend on the repair type and will be explained before work begins.
